# Governance, Compliance, and FinOps {#sec-governance}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.**
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- identify the lawful basis for processing personal data through an LLM under KVKK and GDPR;
- map EU AI Act obligations onto a system you are actually building;
- produce audit logs that answer which agent touched which data under whose authority;
- compute unit economics per session, per task, and per resolved ticket.

## Exercises

1. Compute cost per resolved ticket for an agent, including retries and human escalations. Compare to the human-only baseline.
2. Write the DPIA section covering what happens to a user's message after it reaches a third-party model provider.
